annotatedSteps.description: Subtracting remainders and finding HCF of the reduced numbers
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
85 = 5 × 17
72 = 2³ × 3²
There is no common prime factor, so HCF(85, 72) = 1.
∴ The greatest number is 1.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Did not subtract the remainders before finding the HCF
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking:
Required number = HCF(85 − 1, 72 − 2) = HCF(84, 70).
84 = 2² × 3 × 7
70 = 2 × 5 × 7
HCF(84, 70) = 2 × 7 = 14.
∴ The greatest number is 14.

results.teacherNote: To find a number leaving specific remainders, you must subtract the remainders from the given numbers first (85 − 1 = 84 and 72 − 2 = 70) and then find their HCF.

rubric.point: Finding HCF(84, 70) = 14 and stating the greatest number
